question: A plane electromagnetic wave is represented by $E_y = 60\sin(kx - \omega t)\text{ V m}^{-1}$. It travels in vacuum. Find the magnetic field amplitude and write the corresponding magnetic field if it is along the $z$-direction.

options.B: $B_0=\dfrac{E_0}{c}=2.0\times10^{-7}\text{ T}$ and $B_z=2.0\times10^{-7}\cos(kx-\omega t)\text{ T}$, because the fields are out of phase.
options.D: $B_0=\dfrac{E_0}{c}=\dfrac{60}{3.0\times10^8}=2.0\times10^{-7}\text{ T}$. Since the fields are in phase, $B_z=2.0\times10^{-7}\sin(kx-\omega t)\text{ T}$.
